description.recruits.recruit:
A levy is a state troop, a boy, a grave-thrall, a skavenslave, a gor, a temple-spawn, or a Bloodbound — whoever the banner pays.
He fights close. He can take a shield.
He is not Team 2. He is the host.
description.recruits.shieldman:
A shield levy holds the line for an Elector or a Dawi shield-wall.
Slower. Harder to kill. The province lives behind him.
description.recruits.peaceTreaty: Accept and both banners hold their blades for the term. Tribute may still be due.
